Read a WFDB header file

read_wfdb_header.Rd

Parses the record line of a WFDB .hea file. Headers of annotation-only records (no signals) are supported; their n_samples may be zero, which means the record length is not defined.

Usage

read_wfdb_header(path)

Arguments

path

Path to the .hea file.

Value

A list with record, n_signals, fs, n_samples, base_time, base_date and has_signals.

Examples

hea <- system.file("extdata", "04015.hea", package = "timeledger")
read_wfdb_header(hea)
#> $record
#> [1] "04015"
#> 
#> $n_signals
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $fs
#> [1] 250
#> 
#> $n_samples
#> [1] 9205760
#> 
#> $base_time
#> [1] "9:00:00"
#> 
#> $base_date
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $has_signals
#> [1] TRUE
#>
